title: Mother Ayahuasca gives Hancock a novel's plot

tellings.quote: back in 2006 drinking Ayahuasca in Brazil over a series of five sessions I was given literally given the entire plot of a novel

plain: In 2006, over five sessions drinking ayahuasca, a plant brew that causes visions, in Brazil, the writer Graham Hancock says he was "literally given the entire plot of a novel". He tells it first-hand, crediting the spirit he calls Mother Ayahuasca, and ties it to his novel Entangled. If true, it would mean the visions came from an intelligence outside his own mind.
